title: Deploy temporary flood barriers
description: Temporary flood barriers at ground-level entrances. Very effective up to about 3 ft of water above the first floor.
task_text: {building}: deploy temporary flood barriers at all ground-level entrances. Deadline: {deadline}.
tenant_notice_text: Ground-floor entrances will be closed while flood barriers are in place.

title: Sandbag entrances
description: Sandbags at entrances and loading docks. Cheap; only helps for shallow water (up to 1.5 ft).
task_text: {building}: sandbag all ground-floor entrances and loading docks. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Move ground-floor equipment up
description: Move ground-floor electrical and IT equipment upstairs. Cuts damage and speeds reopening.
task_text: {building}: move ground-floor electrical and IT equipment to level 2 or higher. Deadline: {deadline}.
tenant_notice_text: Please move servers and critical equipment off the ground floor today.

title: Install storm shutters
description: Install storm shutters on exposed glazing before hurricane-force winds.
task_text: {building}: install storm shutters on all exposed glazing. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Secure rooftop units and debris
description: Strap rooftop units and clear loose debris.
task_text: {building}: strap rooftop units and clear loose roof debris. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Top off and pre-book fuel delivery
description: Top off generator fuel and pre-book the next delivery so backup power lasts 24h longer.
task_text: {building}: top off generator fuel and confirm the next delivery slot. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Rent and hook up a portable generator
description: Rent and connect a portable generator for a building with no backup power.
task_text: {building}: receive and connect a rental generator to the transfer switch. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Activate tenant continuity (move critical ops)
description: Critical tenants fail over to their secondary sites, cutting SLA penalties.
task_text: {building}: coordinate tenant failover to their secondary site. Deadline: {deadline}.
tenant_notice_text: Please activate your continuity plan and fail over critical systems before the storm.

title: Drain and heat-trace exposed pipes
description: Drain exposed lines and heat-trace mechanical rooms so pipes do not freeze and burst.
task_text: {building}: drain exposed lines and install heat trace in mechanical rooms. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Pre-book a restoration contractor
description: Retain a restoration contractor before the storm to avoid post-storm demand surge and waiting lists.
task_text: {building}: confirm the restoration contractor retainer and on-site arrival time. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Portable heat in mechanical rooms
description: Portable heaters in mechanical rooms keep pipes above freezing during outages.
task_text: {building}: place portable heaters in all mechanical rooms. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Emergency dry-out and mold prevention
description: Start water extraction and drying right after the event to prevent mold and cut downtime.
task_text: {building}: start emergency water extraction and drying. Deadline: {deadline}.

title: Offer as community help site
description: Open the building as a community help site; residents are routed here by Operation Storm.
task_text: {building}: open the lobby as a community help site (staff, security, cots). Deadline: {deadline}.
